The [[Jahai Rat]] is a [[charmable animal]] that can be found in certain areas of [[Kourna]] and throughout [[Vabbi]]. They are intelligent, curious, and master climbers, and their tails give them excellent balance.

==Locations==
*[[Core]]
**[[The Battle Isles]]
***{{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20, depending on unlock progress)
*[[Nightfall]]
**[[Vabbi]]
***{{NPC location|Garden of Seborhin}} (at the exit into the [[Forum Highlands]])
***{{NPC location|The Hidden City of Ahdashim}}
***{{NPC location|The Mirror of Lyss}} (just outside [[Honur Hill]])
***{{NPC location|Vehtendi Valley}}

==Notes==
*Jahai Rats deal [[slashing damage]].
